entries.englishDefinition: To fail to appreciate the value of someone or something because their presence or help seems certain and familiar.

entries.exampleSentence: People often take reliable public services for granted until those services stop.

entries.englishDefinition: To include relevant facts or circumstances in one's thinking when making a judgment or decision.

entries.exampleSentence: The committee took into account the objections but still approved the plan.

entries.exampleExplanation: the objections가 검토에 넣은 정보이고 but still approved가 최종 결정이다. 반대 의견을 고려했다고 그 의견에 동의하거나 계획을 거부해야 하는 것은 아니다.
